BUNDLE_START {"path":"contact.html","content":" Contact — {{BUSINESS_NAME}}

{{BUSINESS_NAME}}

{{TAGLINE}}
Home About the Work Paths How I Work Fees Help Book Connect

Connect gently — let's talk about next steps

I'm {{THERAPIST_NAME}}. I offer confidential, compassionate therapy rooted in mindfulness and somatic awareness. Use the form to share what brings you here, or call/text {{PHONE}}.

A brief intake check

This is a quick way to name what you're noticing. It does not replace clinical assessment.

See booking options
Prefer to call? {{PHONE}} • Email: {{EMAIL}}

What happens after you reach out

  1. I'll read your message and offer a time for a 15-minute consult call or a first session.
  2. We clarify goals, practicalities, and whether my approach is a good fit.
  3. If we proceed, we'll discuss an initial plan and session frequency.

I work remotely with adults in {{STATE}} (licensed as {{LICENSE}}). If you are outside my jurisdiction, I will let you know in the consult.

Small practices you can try today

Box breathing — 4 in, hold 4, 4 out, hold 4. 1 minute can calm the nervous system.
Sensory check-in — name three things you see, two you can touch, one you hear.
Gentle boundary — practice saying a brief, kind no to something small to notice how you feel.

These are supportive practices; they are not a substitute for therapy when deeper work is needed.

Fee overview — framed options

I offer a few pathways to meet different needs. Full details and sliding-scale availability on the Fees page.

  • Calm Harbor Intro — Single session for orientation; hourly rate applies.
  • Deep Waters Series — 8-session focused package for deeper themes; package pricing available.
  • Maintenance Sessions — Ongoing weekly/biweekly support; standard per-session rate.
Reserve a consult

{{THERAPIST_NAME}}

{{MODALITIES}} • {{LICENSE}}

Sessions are held via secure telehealth and in-person in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} where available. I take a limited number of clients to keep work focused and attentive.

Confidentiality & safety

Conversations are confidential within legal and ethical limits (e.g., risk of harm to self/others, court order). Clinical notes are stored privately.

Crisis notice

If you are in immediate danger or experiencing a psychiatric emergency, call local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room. If you are located in the U.S., you can also call or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.

Scope & boundaries

Therapy is collaborative. I do not provide legal, medical, or forensic services. I will discuss referrals when needs fall outside my scope.

Ready for a gentle first step?

Schedule a 15-minute consult or send a brief message — whichever feels easier.

See full booking

Licensed in {{STATE}} as {{LICENSE}}. Telehealth offered where permitted. Privacy and confidentiality are foundational to this work.

"} {"path":"README.md","content":"# Contact page and instructions for {{BUSINESS_NAME}} This chunk provides the contact page (contact.html) for a private practice therapist site using the "zen_minimal" layout and a calm, teacher-like voice. Files included in this chunk: - contact.html — the full contact page with hero, diagnostic (intake checklist), plan (what happens next), micro_habits (small practices), pricing summary, and CTA sections clearly present. Purpose and structure - The contact page is intentionally spare and focused: gentle hero, a short intake form, clear next steps, practical micro-habits, and a concise framing of fees. - Navigation links point to the rest of the site (index.html, about.html, specialties.html, approach.html, fees.html, faq.html, book.html). - The page includes confidentiality, crisis disclaimer, and scope/boundaries language required for ethical practice. Placeholders - Replace placeholders in the content where appropriate: - {{BUSINESS_NAME}} — practice or business name - {{TAGLINE}} — brief tagline or descriptor - {{PHONE}} — primary phone number for contact - {{EMAIL}} — contact email address - {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} — label for primary call-to-action (e.g., "Request consult") - {{PRIMARY_CTA_URL}} — URL or endpoint for form/CTA - {{THERAPIST_NAME}} — clinician name - {{LICENSE}} — licensing credential and state (e.g., LCSW, LMFT) - {{MODALITIES}} — brief list of modalities (e.g., EMDR, somatic, CBT-informed) - {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} — practice location Design notes - Layout is intentionally minimal with ample white space and a gentle color palette. - No external assets or third-party scripts are included. Replace or add local assets if desired. - The contact form in this demo uses a non-functional onsubmit handler for safe preview. Hook up your backend or form processor at {{PRIMARY_CTA_URL}}. Accessibility & content guidance - Maintain the concise crisis disclaimer and confidentiality note. These are important for both ethics and client safety. - Avoid making guarantees about outcomes or medical claims; language is supportive and realistic. - Keep the tone calm and grounded to match the spiritual_teacher voice while remaining clinically appropriate. Deployment - Drop contact.html into the site root alongside the other templates (index.html, about.html, specialties.html, approach.html, fees.html, faq.html, book.html). - Ensure links to assets (assets/img/*.svg) exist if other chunks include or reference them. Customization tips - Adjust the micro_habits list to reflect simple practices you actually recommend. - Expand the pricing summary on fees.html; the contact page intentionally remains a short summary and referral point to the Fees page. - If you will accept clients only in certain jurisdictions, make that explicit next to licensing and telehealth notes. Legal reminder - This page is not legal advice. Confirm disclaimers with your professional board or legal counsel as needed. If you need updates to the copy tone, alternative CTA labels, or a different micro-habits set, request another revision and specify which placeholders to populate."} BUNDLE_END
